meta.description: Ulti, the IPTV player for iPhone and Apple TV: live TV, guide, movies and series in a simple app that's ready to use.

heros.phrase: Live TV, guide, movies and series: your IPTV subscription becomes an intuitive TV app. Just open it and watch.
heros.bientot: Coming soon to the App Store
heros.neutralite: Ulti does not provide any channels or content.

apercu.etiquette: Preview of the app on Apple TV and iPhone
apercu.indice: Click the screens to try the app.

fonctions.phrase: Ulti turns the thousands of channels and movies in your subscription into clear screens, like a TV app you've always had.
fonctions.directTexte: A ring around each channel shows how far the show has got. Filter by theme and flip from one channel to the next.
fonctions.guideTexte: Tonight, tomorrow, all week. Set a reminder in one gesture, or use your own XMLTV guide.
fonctions.filmsTexte: Posters and summaries, every version of a movie gathered in a single page, and you pick up right where you left off.

legendes.direct: All your channels as large tiles, with what's on now. Filter by theme, then flip through.
legendes.guide: Tonight, tomorrow, all week. A reminder in one gesture, and a line shows where you are.
legendes.replay: Missed a show? Go back to previous days, channel by channel. With Premium.
legendes.films: Posters, summaries and every version of a movie gathered in a single page. With Premium.
legendes.series: Seasons and episodes neatly organised, and you resume right where you left off. With Premium.

appletv.titre: On the TV, you type nothing.
appletv.texte: Scan the code shown on Apple TV with your iPhone: your subscription arrives on the TV, encrypted, directly over your local network.
appletv.point1: Flip channels with the remote, up and down
appletv.point2: Picture in Picture during live TV
appletv.point3: Big posters, designed for the couch
appletv.qrTexte: Point your iPhone's camera at this code.

famille.titre: The whole family, each in their own space.
famille.texte: One profile per person with Premium, each with their own list and resume points. The Kids profile, included in the free version, sees no adult content and can only be exited with the parental code.

premium.films: Movies and series, with posters, summaries and resume
premium.icloud: iCloud sync between iPhone and Apple TV
premium.multi: Multiview, up to 4 live channels at once

etapes.e1Texte: Paste the message from your IPTV provider, or enter its login details. Ulti fills in the rest.
etapes.e2Texte: Channels, guide, movies and series are organised. Keep only the categories you care about.
etapes.e3Texte: On iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. With Premium, your list and resume points follow you.

tarifs.phrase: Live TV is free. Try Premium for 7 days without paying.
tarifs.gratuitTexte: Live TV, TV guide and reminders, Picture in Picture, Apple TV via QR code, one Kids profile.
tarifs.soloLegende: Solo: for you, on all your devices.
tarifs.familleLegende: Family: up to 6 people with Apple Family Sharing.
tarifs.annuelTexte: All of Premium, just {prix} a month. 7-day free trial.
tarifs.prixAppStore: Price shown on the App Store
tarifs.noteAppStore: The exact price for your country is shown on the App Store.

viePrivee.texte: Your login details stay in your device's Keychain. No account to create, no Ulti server.

faq.r1: No. Ulti is a player: it plays the sources you add yourself. Ulti does not provide any channels or content. You must have your own sources, and the right to watch them.
faq.r2: iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Premium works on all your devices with the same Apple Account; with the Family plan, up to 6 people can enjoy it through Family Sharing.
faq.r3: They are kept in your device's Keychain and never go through an Ulti server.
faq.r4: Subscriptions provided as an M3U link or Xtream Codes login details, which covers the vast majority. The easiest way: paste your provider's message, and Ulti recognises the format on its own.
faq.q5: Can I try before I pay?
faq.r5: Yes. Live TV is free. Premium can be tried free for 7 days with the monthly and yearly subscriptions, Solo or Family.

neutralite: Ulti does not provide any channels or content. You must have your own sources, and the right to watch them.
